kite.name: Kite
kite.object: A diamond-shaped kite made of four felt patches in sage, ochre, cream and terracotta, with a short yarn tail tied with three little bows curling below it.

felt-star.name: Felt star
felt-star.object: A plump five-pointed star in soft ochre felt, with chunky cream blanket stitches around its edge.

knitted-ball.name: Knitted ball
knitted-ball.object: A round knitted ball with wide stripes of sage, cream and terracotta wool.

spinning-top.name: Spinning top
spinning-top.object: A wooden spinning top in warm honey wood with two painted rings, one sage and one coral, tilted as if it is still spinning.

tiny-book.name: Tiny book
tiny-book.object: A tiny cloth-bound picture book standing half open, with a dusty lavender cover and thick cream pages fanned apart.

moon-lamp.name: Moon lamp
moon-lamp.object: A small crescent moon night-light in cream clay on a round wooden base, glowing a soft warm gold from inside.

plush-owl.name: Plush owl
plush-owl.object: A small plush owl toy in dusty lavender felt with a cream belly, two big round button eyes and a tiny ochre beak.

paper-crown.name: Paper crown
paper-crown.object: A paper crown in ochre card with three rounded points, each tipped with a small painted coral dot.

paper-boat.name: Paper boat
paper-boat.object: A small folded paper boat in cream paper with one soft blue painted stripe along its hull, sitting upright.

bath-duck.name: Bath duck
bath-duck.object: A small yellow felt bath duck toy with an ochre beak and one stitched dot eye, sitting upright.

spiral-shell.name: Spiral shell
spiral-shell.object: A spiral seashell in pale peach clay with wide, soft ridges and a pearly cream opening.

star-sponge.name: Star sponge
star-sponge.object: A soft star-shaped bath sponge in muted coral, with rounded points and large visible pores.

wooden-spoon.name: Wooden spoon
wooden-spoon.object: A wooden spoon in warm honey wood with a deep round bowl, lying at a gentle diagonal.

bread-roll.name: Bread roll
bread-roll.object: A small round bread roll with a golden crust and a single deep score across its top.

clay-pear.name: Pear
clay-pear.object: A ripe pear in muted green clay with a short brown stem and one small sage felt leaf.

cupcake.name: Cupcake
cupcake.object: A small cupcake in a terracotta paper case, with a cream frosting swirl and one coral felt cherry on top.

acorn.name: Acorn
acorn.object: A plump acorn in warm brown clay with a textured, darker cap and a tiny curled stem.

oak-leaf.name: Oak leaf
oak-leaf.object: A single oak leaf in muted ochre felt with chunky stitched veins and a short stem.

feather.name: Feather
feather.object: One soft cream feather with a dusty blue tip, curving gently, its edge slightly fluffed.

smiling-pebble.name: Smiling pebble
smiling-pebble.object: A smooth flat pebble in blue-gray clay with a small, simple painted cream smile and two dot eyes.

golden-key.name: Golden key
golden-key.object: A small old-fashioned key in soft brushed gold, with a round looped handle and two simple teeth.

paper-lantern.name: Paper lantern
paper-lantern.object: A round paper lantern in warm cream paper with thin ribs, glowing gold from inside, with a short loop on top.

hot-air-balloon.name: Hot-air balloon
hot-air-balloon.object: A tiny hot-air balloon made of coral and cream felt panels, with a small woven basket hanging below.

star-jar.name: Jar of stars
star-jar.object: A small glass jar with a cork stopper, holding three tiny glowing golden stars.
